installer.title: One-click model download
installer.intro: Checks which checkpoints / LoRAs / video base models each visual style needs and downloads the missing ones into the program's model folders. Hugging Face first, then the hf-mirror.com mirror on failure, then Civitai and its mirror; resumable, SHA256-verified.
installer.localDisabled: Local installs are disabled on this server (MODEL_INSTALLER_LOCAL=0); use remote mode.
installer.privateKey: Paste the private key, or use "Choose key file…" above
installer.remoteHint: The remote machine needs SSH: macOS → System Settings → General → Sharing → Remote Login; Linux → openssh-server; Windows → "OpenSSH Server" (Settings → Optional features). macOS and Linux both accept password and key (certificate) login. Remote downloads run in the background there and finish even if UU889-Drama is closed.
installer.notFound: {app} was not found in the usual places; pick the folder with Browse… (detection is more accurate while the service is running)
installer.auto: Download missing models automatically when generating
installer.autoHint: Before an image / video is generated, the models for the project's style are checked and missing ones downloaded (progress shows in the task); generation starts when they are done.
installer.preferMirrorHint: Try hf-mirror.com before huggingface.co (recommended in mainland China).
installer.civitaiPlaceholder: Only needed for Civitai-only files (civitai.com → Account settings → API Keys)
installer.hfPlaceholder: Usually not needed (none of these repos are gated)
installer.sourcesHint: Civitai now requires an API key for every download; Civitai models with an identical copy on Hugging Face (same SHA256) are downloaded from Hugging Face with no key.
installer.saveHint: Install location, tokens and auto-download are saved with this config; downloads can start without saving.
installer.started: Download started; you can close settings — it continues in the background
installer.passwordHint: macOS Remote Login and most Linux servers accept passwords by default; if password login is disabled (PasswordAuthentication no), use key login.
installer.keyTooBig: That file is too large to be a private key
installer.keyHint: Supports OpenSSH (~/.ssh/id_ed25519, id_rsa, id_ecdsa), PEM (.pem / .key from cloud consoles), PKCS#8 and PuTTY .ppk (v2 / v3). Enter the passphrase for protected keys. The matching public key must be in the remote user’s ~/.ssh/authorized_keys.
installer.fingerprintHint: On first connect, compare with ssh-keygen -lf /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key.pub on the server

aiask.concurrentHint: aiask.me Grok videos are generated upstream by wokey.ai, which limits concurrent videos and rejects the rest. Batches are queued at this number, the next one is sent when one finishes, and busy errors are resubmitted automatically. Raise it if your account allows more.

video.maxDurationHint: Per shot (one video), not the length of the merged export. Empty or 0 = no limit (default). When set, the AI keeps each shot within it and splits shots that don't fit.
video.maxPromptBytes: Max shot video prompt length (UTF-8 bytes)
video.maxPromptBytesHint: Empty or 0 = no limit (default); directives are appended in full. With a number (or with Grok video, whose API allows 4096 bytes) the limited mode applies: the AI writes the prompt to about 45% of it, and the style words and every directive have their own length caps in a compact version, so the total stays under the limit. If it is still over, only the end of the text is shortened and the directives are kept. A Chinese character is 3 bytes, a line break 2.
video.moderationRetriesHint: How many times to resubmit unchanged when moderation blocks a video (Grok moderation is inconsistent; a clean prompt often passes on resubmit). Empty = 2, 0 = never.

direction.blockingHint: for continuity: opening positions + end state
direction.blockingPlaceholder: Opening: Ming sits by the window, frame left; Hong enters from the door, frame right. End: Hong sits across from Ming (frame right), they look at each other across the table.

timingHint.ok: Duration matches the lines. Generation locks these lines; nobody speaks the rest of the time.
timingHint.too_long: About {idle}s with nobody speaking — video models tend to invent lines (gibberish). Shorten the shot to fit the lines, or describe concrete action for that time.
timingHint.too_short: The lines do not fit ({idle}s short) and will be cut off or rushed. Lengthen the shot or move some lines to the next one.

direction.dialogueLock: Lock dialogue (only these lines, no improvised speech)
direction.dialogueLockTip: Adds dialogue control: only the lines in the description, word for word, then silence; shots without lines tell everyone to keep quiet.
direction.appearanceLockTip: Adds character look and outfit text, scene layout and style-consistency requirements to keep faces and art style from drifting.
direction.continuityTip: Adds this shot's blocking and the previous same-scene shot's end state to the prompt and keeps left/right positions.
direction.chain: Open from the previous shot's last frame
direction.chainTip: After the previous same-scene shot is generated, its last frame becomes this shot's first frame or first reference. In batch generation, same-scene shots run one after another; if a shot fails (moderation misjudgments are retried automatically first), the shots after it are paused.
direction.noPrev: Different scene from the previous shot — this shot opens a new scene.
direction.prevTextOnly: Continues from the end blocking of shot #{n} (without its image).
direction.prevNoVideo: Shot #{n} has no video yet: generate it first so this shot can continue from its last frame.
direction.prevAsFirst: Opens from the last frame of shot #{n} as the first frame.
direction.prevAsRef: Uses the last frame of shot #{n} as reference 1 so the opening positions match.
direction.chainBatch: Continuity is on: {n} group(s) of same-scene shots will be generated in order, each continuing from the previous last frame.
direction.chainPaused: Previous shot #{n} did not generate, and this shot continues from its last frame, so it was paused and not submitted. Once #{n} has a video, click Retry failed to continue in order.
direction.chainPausedToast: #{n} did not generate. The {count} same-scene shot(s) that continue from it were paused and not submitted, so no credits are spent on mismatched footage.
direction.qualityLockTip: Appends [Quality]: sharp image with clear facial features, hair and fabric texture; no blur, smearing or plastic look. Never removed when a long prompt is shortened.
direction.physicsLockTip: Adds a [Physics] directive: gravity, planted feet, real grip, no clipping or morphing, natural speed. Local open models (e.g. small-VRAM MiniMax H3 tiers) break physics most often.

systemVoice.panel: Show a holographic panel when it speaks (light only, no text)
systemVoice.hint: Lines written as "{name}: \"…\"" or 【Ding! …】 in a shot are treated as the system: the chime plays, then it speaks in the voice above, and nobody on screen moves their lips. With subtitles, system lines are bracketed and cyan. Needs a video model that generates audio (e.g. Seedance, Veo, Grok); local Wan 2.2 has no audio. Regenerate prompts / videos after changing this.

engineDesc.fast: Lanczos scaling + sharpening, done in seconds without the GPU; limited gain in detail

upscale.note: The upscaled video is saved as a new history entry and becomes the current video; the original is kept and you can switch back in the history. Subtitled videos are upscaled with their subtitles. Shots with different resolutions are unified when merging.

errors.timeout: Generation timed out. Please try again.
errors.moderation: Content was blocked by moderation. Adjust the prompt or switch models and retry.

welcome.title: 👋 Welcome to UU889-Drama
welcome.desc: Novel → script → assets → storyboard → video → final cut, all in one place. Configure AI services first, then create your first project.

create.title: Step 2 · Create a project
create.desc: Click "New Project": name it, pick an aspect ratio (landscape/portrait) and a visual style.

settings.title: Step 1 · Configure AI services
settings.desc: Every AI feature needs this first. Open Settings and paste an aiask.me API Key to set up text/image/video in one click.

quick.title: Fastest setup: Quick Setup
quick.desc: Paste an aiask.me API Key to write the three recommended configs (text/image/video) at once, with connectivity testing.

nav.title: Everything lives here
nav.desc: Switch sections on the left: AI services, general (UI & content language), style presets, agent prompts & skills, storage, about.

topbar.title: Top bar: models & status
topbar.desc: Switch the text/image/video model for this session any time; resolution and duration tiers follow the model.

script.title: Step 1 · Script
script.desc: (Prerequisite: AI services configured in Settings.) Paste the source novel and run "AI Rewrite" to get a shooting script.

assets.title: Step 2 · Assets
assets.desc: Extract characters/scenes/props and generate consistent reference images, injected as reference material for videos.

videos.title: Step 3 · Video production
videos.desc: Break down the storyboard → review prompts → batch-generate videos; retry failures in one click. Then merge & export.

help.title: Replay anytime
help.desc: Click this "?" button to replay this page's guide. Happy creating!
